metadata.name: Enterobacteria
metadata.description: Enterobacteria are bacteria from the family Enterobacteriaceae, which are primarily known for their ability to cause intestinal upset. Enterobacteria are responsible for a variety of human illnesses, including urinary tract infections, wound infections, gastroenteritis, meningitis, septicemia, and pneumonia. Some are true intestinal pathogens; whereas others are merely opportunistic pests which attack weakened victims
